name: Nursing Home Inspection & Deficiency Tracker
description: Cross-linked database of nursing home deficiencies, penalties, ownership (incl PE/REIT), staffing, and quality measures from CMS data
notes: CLIENT-READY. 730,114 records from 6 CMS datasets. 14,710 facilities across 53 states. 506 PE-owned, 184 REIT-owned identified. $480M in tracked fines. 99.8% quality above threshold. All exports, methodology doc, outreach package (16 targets) complete.

name: State PUC Rate Case Tracker
description: Structured database of utility rate case filings and decisions across state public utility commissions
notes: CLIENT-READY. 621 rate cases (582 real from OR PUC + 39 from PA/CA/IN/WA). 467 unique utilities across 5 states. Date range 1990-2024. $23B total requested, $10.5B approved revenue. Avg quality 0.670, 100% above threshold. 186 tests passing. 7 problems resolved. Outreach (17 targets, 3 templates), methodology doc, exports (CSV/JSON/Excel/Markdown), dashboard all complete.
